contract: GET /api/sessions. Admin history supports user/sort/desc/itemsPerPage/page filters and returns total/numPages/page/itemsPerPage/sessions plus optional userId with historical null/device fields; non-admin returns 404.
exceptions: Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.

invariants.contract: GET /api/sessions as an admin answers {total, numPages, page, itemsPerPage, sessions, userId} where each stored session is the old playback document (id, userId, libraryId, libraryItemId, bookId, episodeId, mediaType, mediaMetadata, chapters [], displayTitle, displayAuthor, coverPath, duration, playMethod, mediaPlayer, deviceInfo or {}, serverVersion, date, dayOfWeek, timeListening, startTime, currentTime, startedAt, updatedAt) plus user {id, username}; it filters by user uuid, sorts by the validated key (default updatedAt) in asc/desc, pages with itemsPerPage (default 10) and page (default 0), ignores a non-uuid user filter, and answers 404 to a non-admin and 401 unauthenticated. A stored session whose user was deleted answers userId null and user null.
exceptions: Assertion leads only; missing normal/error/edge and state-transition proof must be supplied by the owning packet.
